title: Asahina Mafuyu — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K. Could you check the lyrics for the chorus? I tweaked it a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh. In that case, would you also look over my rough sketch? I feel like I did really well with this one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll have a look at them.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, everyone! Phew, so glad I made it!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Made it? Only by a matter of seconds.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I was on a roll while working offline, and completely lost track of time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, that wasn't the point... I mean, the date's about to roll over! We've got to give you our well-wishes, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can't with you... You were so excited about wishing her a happy birthday right on the dot, and then you never showed. I was wondering what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, my bad. But I made it on time, so we're good!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm so excited for the party in SEKAI tomorrow. Will you be able to make it, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I've got club activities, but I should be able to make it back at night.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Really? Great! We better get everything prepared by then!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of parties... Yuki, didn't Ms. Mochizuki also invite you to another one?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. She asked if I was free during lunch...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're going to have a party at school too, huh. What's the plan?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm sure there's a bunch of things planned for you behind the scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow, what happened to the time?! It's almost midnight! Okay, everyone ready?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ready? Were you planning on counting down?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Of course! C'mon, here we go! 3, 2, 1. Happy birthday, Mafuyu!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay. I'm going to go back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. Well, I guess that's our Yuki for you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Have fun at the party at school!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright, does everyone have a party popper?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really didn't expect such a big celebration.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We have a lot planned for you, so I hope you have a great time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We also prepared a bunch of food. I say “we,” but all we did is help Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've packed pot-au-feu in this soup jar. Please have some, if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll have some later to keep myself warm.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ Okey dokey, us next! Please accept this gift!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. Is this from all of you? May I open it now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wow... This scarf looks so warm and cozy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We picked it out together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We went with a simple design that can match our school uniform. I hope you like it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we can also guarantee it'll keep you warm! It's earned our seal of approval!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: These two spent time trying on all of the scarves in the store.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, it was for a gift! We wanted to make sure that she could wear it all throughout the winter♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, everyone. It's only going to get colder, so I'll be sure to make good use of this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I was a little surprised when they said we're celebrating on the rooftop... But it was more normal than I thought.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why are there instruments and speakers over there?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, are you curious about those?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, who wouldn't be, when there's a bunch of instruments placed in plain sight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since Asahina has already noticed, let's move on to our special segment!
